facts.text: Le Meurice is at 228 rue de Rivoli, opposite the Tuileries Garden and a five-minute walk from the Louvre.
facts.excerpt: Le Meurice is at 228 rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, opposite the Tuileries Garden and a 5-minute walk from The Louvre.

facts.text: From the hotel entrance you see the Louvre to the left and the Eiffel Tower to the right.
facts.excerpt: From its entrance, you'll see the Louvre to your left, just five minutes' walk away, and the Eiffel Tower to your right.

facts.text: Le Meurice has been known as the hotel of artists and free spirits since 1835.
facts.excerpt: Known as the hotel of artists and free spirits since 1835

facts.text: Pablo Picasso hosted his wedding banquet at Le Meurice.
facts.excerpt: Pablo Picasso hosted his wedding banquet at Le Meurice.

facts.text: The dining room of Restaurant le Meurice Alain Ducasse is inspired by the Salon de la Paix at Versailles and reinterpreted by Philippe Starck.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the Salon de la Paix at the Château de Versailles and reinterpreted by Philippe Starck

facts.text: Restaurant le Meurice Alain Ducasse holds two Michelin stars, with executive chef Amaury Bouhours.
facts.excerpt: Overseen by Alain Ducasse with executive chef Amaury Bouhours, Restaurant le Meurice Alain Ducasse has become the epicurean address in Paris, presenting a whole new way of enjoying the two-Michelin-starred experience.

facts.text: Hotel guests dining at Restaurant le Meurice Alain Ducasse are welcomed with a complimentary glass of Dom Perignon 2017.
facts.excerpt: If you're staying at Le Meurice, we'll welcome you with a complimentary glass of Dom Pérignon 2017.

facts.text: The Chef's Table offers a view into the kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a unique dining experience at the Chef’s Table of Le Meurice Alain Ducasse, with a view into the kitchen

facts.text: Restaurant le Dali serves seasonal French cuisine in an artistic setting designed by Philippe Starck.
facts.excerpt: Restaurant le Dalí serves seasonal French cuisine in an artistic setting designed by Philippe Starck.

facts.text: Chef Clementine Bouchon, chosen by Alain Ducasse, leads the kitchen at Le Dali with dishes that celebrate French classics.
facts.excerpt: Chosen by Alain Ducasse, chef Clémentine Bouchon redefines tradition at Le Dalí. Her dishes celebrate French classics

facts.text: Cedric Grolet's tea time, with his Fruits Sculptes, is served in Restaurant Le Dali.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Cedric Grolet's spectacular Fruits Sculptés in an equally exceptional setting: Restaurant Le Dalí at Le Meurice.

facts.text: Cedric Grolet joined Le Meurice in 2011 and became its head pastry chef.
facts.excerpt: Cedric Grolet joined Le Meurice in 2011, swiftly becoming our head pastry chef

facts.text: Cedric Grolet was named The World's Best Pastry Chef in 2018.
facts.excerpt: he was named ‘The World’s Best Pastry Chef’ in 2018

facts.text: The pastry boutique is at 6 rue de Castiglione and has no seating.
facts.excerpt: Buy, or collect your order, at 6 rue de Castiglione, 75001, Paris. Please note that the pastry shop has no seating.

facts.text: Bar 228 has live jazz every night.
facts.excerpt: This is where Parisians settle down into deep leather armchairs and discreet conversation, enraptured by our nightly live jazz.

facts.text: Philippe Starck refreshed Bar 228 with a Carrara marble bar counter, keeping its dark woods and painted ceiling.
facts.excerpt: Philippe Starck has refreshed this famously beautiful room with a Carrara marble bar counter and flashes of pink copper, brass and stainless steel. The dark woods and painted ceiling remain

facts.text: Bar 228 does not take reservations except for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Reservations are not accepted, except for hotel guests

facts.text: La Maison Valmont pour Le Meurice is the only Valmont spa in Paris.
facts.excerpt: Le Meurice features the only Valmont spa in Paris

facts.text: The spa has hammams and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Sink into serenity in our hammams or sauna

facts.text: The fitness studio uses Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: Whether you're working out using the latest Technogym equipment

facts.text: The Superior Room, Eiffel View with Balcony sits under the Mansard roof and has a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Your peaceful retreat under our distinctive Mansard roof, where bespoke décor lines the walls for an added touch of artistry. A private step-out balcony offers you the famous city skyline in one enchanted gaze

facts.text: The Junior Suite is designed by Lally and Berger.
facts.excerpt: A beautifully light and spacious suite, dressed by visionary designers Lally & Berger.

facts.text: The Deluxe Room, like many other rooms, can connect to an additional room or suite.
facts.excerpt: Like many other rooms, it can connect to an additional room or suite, providing endless possibilities for friends and families to create their own Parisian apartment.

facts.text: Parking is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Parking is complimentary.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes up to two small dogs per room, for a daily fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, we welcome up to two small dogs (under 7 kg/15 lbs) per room, at €40 per day to cover deep cleaning.

facts.text: Salon Pompadour has 19th-century decor that evokes the grandeur of Versailles.
facts.excerpt: The sparkling 19th century décor of this stunning stateroom evokes the grandeur of Versailles

facts.text: The hotel runs Legendary Artists walking trails with an expert guide, including one through the Tuileries Garden to the Musee Rodin.
facts.excerpt: As part of our Legendary Artists’ series of walking trails, join us on an intriguing bespoke trail through the Tuileries Garden to the Musée Rodin with our expert guide.

facts.text: Le Meurice was named the number one hotel in Paris in La Liste's 2026 ranking.
facts.excerpt: Named the N°1 hotel in Paris in La Liste's 2026 ranking

facts.text: The rooms and suites have been newly restored.
facts.excerpt: Discover our selection of newly-restored rooms and suites
